# Batches

Bulk sending: submit a batch of recipients, read its validation report and items, then start or stop it. For developers sending the same or templated content to many recipients.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | [`/v1/messages/batch`](#post-v1messagesbatch) | Stage a message batch for later admission |
| GET | [`/v1/batches/{id}`](#get-v1batchesid) | Get batch detail |
| GET | [`/v1/batches/{id}/validation`](#get-v1batchesidvalidation) | Get batch validation results |
| POST | [`/v1/batches/{id}/start`](#post-v1batchesidstart) | Admit eligible rows and start a ready batch |
| POST | [`/v1/batches/{id}/stop`](#post-v1batchesidstop) | Stop a batch |
| GET | [`/v1/batches/{id}/items`](#get-v1batchesiditems) | List messages in a batch |

## POST /v1/messages/batch

**Stage a message batch for later admission**

Operation ID: `createBatch`. Tag: `Batches`.

**Auth:** API key with scope `messages:write`, or session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `1`, maxLength `255`. |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

Schema: [BatchInput](schemas.md#batchinput).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of [BatchItem](schemas.md#batchitem) | yes |  |  |
| `dedupe` | boolean | no | `true` |  |

**Request body** (`text/csv`, required)

Type: string (binary).

**Request body** (`multipart/form-data`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | string (binary) | yes |  |  |
| `dedupe` | boolean | no | `true` |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `202` | Batch accepted. | `application/json`: [Batch](schemas.md#batch) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `409` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

**Example**

<!-- tabs label="Request example" -->
```bash tab="cURL"
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/messages/batch" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_VG0...' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: docs-586f73ae-4ce7-4053-b670-82c8e3489c40' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "items": [
    {
      "to": "+254712345678",
      "text": "Hi Amina, your order has shipped."
    },
    {
      "to": "+254722000111",
      "text": "Hi Brian, your order has shipped."
    },
    {
      "to": "0700",
      "text": "bad number"
    }
  ]
}'
```

## GET /v1/batches/{id}

**Get batch detail**

Operation ID: `getBatch`. Tag: `Batches`.

Status, totals, estimated cost and timestamps for one batch. Workspace and environment scoped; batches in other workspaces or environments return 404.

**Auth:** API key with scope `messages:read`, or session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Batch detail. | `application/json`: [Batch](schemas.md#batch) |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `403` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `404` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

The start call succeeds. Here the workspace owner had not verified their email yet, so every row was refused at admission and the batch ended `failed`.

<!-- /tabs -->

Response `409` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Conflict",
  "status": 409,
  "detail": "batch cannot be stopped in its current state"
}
```

Only a batch that is still running can be stopped. This one had already finished, so the answer is `409`.

## GET /v1/batches/{id}/items

**List messages in a batch**

Operation ID: `listBatchItems`. Tag: `Batches`.

**Auth:** API key with scope `messages:read`, or session token (`Authorization: Bearer sess_...`).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Workspace-ID` | header | string (uuid) | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. Must identify an undeleted workspace where the active user is a member. API keys use their own workspace and ignore this header. |
| `X-Environment` | header | string | no |  | Required with a session bearer token. API keys use their own environment and ignore this header. One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `status` | query | string | no |  | One of: `queued`, `scheduled`, `held`, `sending`, `sent`, `delivered`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `expired`. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | `100` | Constraints: minimum `1`, maximum `1000`. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no |  | Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Batch messages with cursor pagination. | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `401` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |
| `404` | The request could not be completed. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of [Message](schemas.md#message) | yes |  |  |
| `next_cursor` | string \| null | yes |  |  |

**Example**

<!-- tabs label="Request example" -->
```bash tab="cURL"
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/batches/959d8d9f-e177-4d5b-a62c-e25a66563a59/items" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_VG0...'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const opensms = new Opensms({ apiKey: process.env.OPENSMS_API_KEY! });

const page = await opensms.batches.listItems(
  '959d8d9f-e177-4d5b-a62c-e25a66563a59',
);

for (const item of page.items) {
  console.log(item.id, item.status);
}
```

```python tab="Python"
client = Opensms(api_key=os.environ["OPENSMS_API_KEY"])

page = client.batches.list_items("959d8d9f-e177-4d5b-a62c-e25a66563a59")

for item in page.items:
    print(item["id"], item["status"])
```

```go tab="Go"
client, err := opensms.NewClient(os.Getenv("OPENSMS_API_KEY"))
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
ctx := context.Background()

page, err := client.Batches.ListItems(
	ctx,
	"959d8d9f-e177-4d5b-a62c-e25a66563a59",
	opensms.ListBatchItemsParams{},
)
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
for _, item := range page.Items {
	fmt.Println(item.ID, item.Status)
}
```

```php tab="PHP"
}
```

